item.title: BigCommerce Legacy Theme Migration to Modern Stencil – IXIL USA
item.description:
750-1500 USD | # BigCommerce Legacy Theme Migration to Modern Stencil – IXIL USA
**Project Type:** Fixed Price **Budget:** $750–$1,500 USD **Website:** https://www.ixilusa.com **Preferred Theme:** BigCommerce Cornerstone Light (Stencil) **Timeline:** Approximately 2–4 weeks
## Project Overview
We are seeking an experienced BigCommerce developer to migrate our established motorcycle exhaust e-commerce website from the legacy **BigCommerce Default v6.6 (Blueprint) theme** to a modern Stencil theme.
We want to preserve our existing website's appearance, branding, navigation, products, and functionality while improving mobile responsiveness, performance, and compatibility.
**This is a theme migration, NOT a complete redesign or platform change.**
## 1. Theme Migration and Design
- Use the free BigCommerce Cornerstone Light theme or recommend a suitable alternative. - Preserve our existing logo, colors, branding, homepage, banners, menus, and general appearance. - Maintain product and category layouts as closely as practical. - Improve performance and compatibility. - Deliver a fully responsive website for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
**Mobile optimization is essential**, including navigation, product pages, fitment searches, cart, and checkout.
## 2. Motorcycle Fitment Selector – Search Magic
Our existing "Select Your Ride" motorcycle make/model/year selector is powered by the BigCommerce **Search Magic app ($49/month)**.
- Preserve the existing app and all fitment data. - Integrate it correctly with the new Stencil theme. - Ensure accurate motorcycle make/model/year searches. - Test full functionality on desktop and mobile.
This is an existing third-party app. We are NOT requesting a new fitment system.
## 3. CRITICAL – Google SEO and URL Preservation
**Protecting our existing Google rankings and indexed pages is a top priority.**
The developer MUST:
- Preserve ALL existing product, category, and informational page URLs exactly as they currently exist. - Preserve SEO titles, meta descriptions, canonical tags, structured data, and existing 301 redirects. - Maintain internal links, Google Search Console verification, analytics, and sitemap functionality. - Prevent broken links, duplicate pages, and accidental indexing restrictions. - Document and audit existing URLs before migration and verify them after launch. - Obtain written approval before changing ANY existing URL. - Implement proper 301 redirects if an approved URL change is unavoidable.
The migration must follow SEO best practices to minimize any risk to our established Google traffic. SEO verification must be included in the fixed price.
## 4. Customer Accounts, Checkout, and Integrations
Our current legacy theme has a customer registration issue involving reCAPTCHA.
Requirements:
- Fix customer registration and ensure BigCommerce-supported CAPTCHA protection works correctly. - Preserve existing customer accounts and order history. - Verify customer login and account management. - Preserve and test PayPal and BigCommerce checkout. - Confirm compatibility with our existing ShipStation integration. - Test the complete purchase process on desktop and mobile.
## 5. Development, Testing, and Launch
- Develop using an unpublished theme or separate development environment. - Keep our existing live website operational throughout development. - Provide a working preview for approval. - Test navigation, Search Magic, customer accounts, checkout, mobile functionality, and SEO. - Back up the existing theme and establish a rollback plan. - Launch ONLY after receiving our written approval.
## 6. Ownership and Post-Launch Support
- Deliver all completed custom theme files and newly developed code. - Transfer ownership of newly created custom work to IXIL USA upon final payment, excluding third-party licensed components. - Disclose any additional software or licensing costs before proceeding. - Include **14 days of post-launch support** to correct migration-related issues involving SEO, links, Search Magic, checkout, customer accounts, or mobile functionality.
## 7. Developer Qualifications and Bidding Requirements
We require demonstrated experience with **BigCommerce Stencil development**, preferably including legacy Blueprint-to-Stencil migrations.
Please include in your proposal:
1. Examples of BigCommerce websites you have developed or migrated. 2. Your experience migrating Blueprint themes to Stencil. 3. Whether you recommend Cornerstone Light or another theme. 4. Confirmation you can preserve existing URLs, SEO, and Search Magic functionality. 5. Your approach to fixing the customer registration/reCAPTCHA issue. 6. Your complete fixed-price quote and estimated completion time. 7. Confirmation that 14 days of post-launch support are included.
**Please review https://www.ixilusa.com before bidding. Generic proposals without relevant BigCommerce experience will not be considered.**
## Final Priorities
Our priorities are preserving existing Google visibility and URLs, maintaining our IXIL USA branding, upgrading desktop/mobile functionality, keeping Search Magic operational, and ensuring a smooth migration without disrupting our business.
**Fixed Budget: $750–$1,500 USD.**
We are looking for a reliable BigCommerce specialist who can complete the migration correctly and potentially assist with future website improvements.

item.title: Mountain Biking Streetwear Brand Website
item.description:
30-250 AUD | Create a premium, modern, high-converting website for my mountain biking brand, **OUTLAW STUDIO**.
The website should feel like a high-end mountain biking and streetwear brand. It needs to look professionally designed, modern, minimalistic and visually impressive.
### 1. Brand identity and colours - Primary colours: Black, white and pink, matching the Outlaw Studio logo. - Use black as the dominant colour, with pink as an accent throughout the website. - Use modern, bold typography. - The overall aesthetic should feel premium, youthful, sporty and professional. - Avoid generic Shopify templates and outdated website designs. - Make the website feel like an established international MTB clothing brand.
### 2. Homepage Create an impressive homepage with:
- A large, full-width hero section featuring mountain biking photography. - Prominent OUTLAW STUDIO branding. - A strong headline that represents the brand. - A clear SHOP NOW button. - High-quality mountain biking photography. - Smooth, subtle animations and transitions. - Featured products and collections. - A section highlighting our latest products. - A promotional section for current discounts and special offers. - A section introducing the Outlaw Studio team.
### 3. Mountain biking photography gallery This is an important feature.
I currently have three mountain biking photographs that I want to use throughout the website.
However, I need the website to support adding unlimited additional photographs in the future without having to redesign the website.
Requirements: - Make the photography section visually impressive. - Allow me to upload additional photos whenever I want. - Automatically adapt the layout as more photos are added. - Support different image sizes and orientations. - Use high-quality images without slowing down the website. - Include a professional gallery layout.
### 4. Meet Our Team page Create a dedicated Meet Our Team page.
It should include: - Individual profiles for team members and sponsored riders. - Their photos. - Their names and short biographies. - Their social media links. - Their riding backgrounds and achievements.
Make it easy for me to add new team members as Outlaw Studio grows.
### 5. Discounts and promotions Create a dedicated promotional section where customers can see current discounts and offers.
Include: - Discount banners. - Special offers. - Bundle deals. - Promotional product sections. - Clear calls to action.
Make promotions easy to update without editing the website's code.
### 6. Shop and product pages Create a premium shopping experience.
- Modern product cards. - High-quality product photography. - Clear product pricing. - Product descriptions. - Product variants and sizes. - Add-to-cart functionality. - Related product recommendations. - Clean and simple checkout experience.
The shopping experience should be easy to navigate on both desktop and mobile.
### 7. Website performance Performance is extremely important.
- The website must load extremely quickly. - Avoid unnecessary animations and heavy scripts. - Optimise all photographs. - Use lazy loading for images. - Make navigation instant and responsive. - Ensure smooth scrolling. - Optimise for mobile devices.
I do not want a laggy website under any circumstances.
### 8. Conversion optimisation The website needs to be designed with the goal of maximising sales.
Use proven ecommerce conversion principles: - Clear SHOP NOW buttons. - Strong product photography. - Easy navigation. - Minimal distractions. - Strategic promotional banners. - Trust-building sections. - Clear pricing and product information. - Mobile-first shopping experience. - Simple checkout process.
Make it easy for someone visiting the website for the first time to understand the brand and purchase a product.
### 9. Navigation Create a clean navigation system with:
- Home - Shop - Meet Our Team - About Us - Contact
Include a shopping cart icon and make the navigation particularly good on mobile.
### 10. Future scalability The website must be easy to expand as Outlaw Studio grows.
I want to be able to: - Add unlimited mountain biking photographs. - Add new products and collections. - Add new team members. - Update discounts. - Change homepage banners. - Add new website sections.
These features should be manageable without needing to rebuild the website.
### FINAL DESIGN DIRECTION
The finished website should look like a premium international MTB streetwear brand.
Take inspiration from high-end streetwear, mountain biking brands and modern ecommerce websites.
Do not make it look like a basic template. Focus on exceptional design, strong branding, premium photography, fast performance and a shopping experience that converts visitors into customers.
Use the Outlaw Studio black and pink identity consistently throughout the entire website.

item.title: AI Bot development issues
item.description:
250-750 AUD | I'm developing an AI bot for private use and need to refine its design and user experience.
Key improvements needed: - Streamlining the bot's functionality for efficiency - Enhancing overall design for better usability **Title: cTrader C# Developer Needed to Audit and Align an Adaptive Demo and Live Trading Bot**
I’m looking for an experienced cTrader Automate/C# developer to investigate and fix differences between my cloud demo bot and local live-account bot.
The project is **Jye Gold V8 Adaptive**, currently used for **XAUUSD on five-minute candles with Pepperstone**. I have the existing source code, compiled builds, parameter exports, journals, test results and saved local learning checkpoints.
**The main problem**
The demo and live versions were intended to use the same adaptive strategy, with the additional account permissions needed for live trading. In practice, their behaviour and results have differed.
The live bot has sometimes opened and closed trades within seconds, including taking very small profits or losses. Logs show that some of these exits came from the model deciding its expected edge had faded or reversed, rather than the trailing stop being hit. I need the developer to establish whether those decisions are correct, whether the forecasts are being applied consistently, and why the demo behaves differently.
**What has already been identified**
- The demo and live instances have separate learned model states. Copying the strategy code and parameters did not transfer the demo’s accumulated learning. - An earlier exit-buffer change was applied only to the live version. That change was subsequently removed, and the latest live candidate’s decision engine was matched to the demo engine and checked with replay tests. - Other repairs have addressed quote changes during saving that cancelled entry attempts, a delayed trade-closure/checkpoint issue, and position ownership problems caused by shared labels between bot copies. - Local learning restoration has been implemented and observed working through restarts of the same instance. - The cloud demo’s model is currently held in memory for that run. A verified export and durable recovery mechanism for its exact learned state remains unresolved.
These are the recorded findings so far. I want the current installed versions and native logs audited, rather than assuming every earlier issue is still present or that all repairs are fully proven.
**What I need done**
1. Compare the actual demo and live builds, parameters, model states and execution paths. 2. Reproduce the rapid exits and explain the precise entry and exit decisions, including conflicting short- and longer-horizon forecasts. 3. Check candle timing, tick updates, bid/ask prices, spread, commissions, slippage and execution delays. 4. Establish a reliable model-only export/import process where supported. Keep account-specific positions, orders and ownership records separate. 5. Verify restart recovery, duplicate-order prevention and isolation between multiple instances. 6. Preserve the intended stop-loss, trailing-stop and sizing behaviour. Any strategy changes should be clearly explained and tested against the baseline. 7. Reconcile results using this bot’s confirmed trades and net results after costs, separately from manual trades and unrelated account history.
**Deliverables**
I want a clear root-cause report, corrected source and compiled package, a documented list of changes, and reproducible test evidence. Given identical model state and market inputs, the strategy decisions should match; genuine broker/execution differences should be explained.
Initial testing should use simulation or demo. Live activation will remain under my control.
Please include your relevant cTrader/C# experience, how you would investigate this, and separate estimates for the initial audit and subsequent fixes. I’m looking for reliable, measurable engineering work—not a promise of guaranteed profits.
Source code and redacted supporting records can be provided privately.
Ideal Skills and Experience: - Expertise in AI bot design - Strong background in UX/UI design - Experience in optimizing bot interactions
Looking for a freelancer who can ensure my AI bot is user-friendly and visually appealing. It’s currently demo trial has had great results but the live trial seems to be not working the same the project has been developed with chat gpt and vis code on ctrader platform

item.title: Build Modern Pushpay-Integrated Church Platform
item.description:
200-300 USD | Project Title: Developer Needed for Modern Mega-Church Web Platform (Pushpay Integration & Zero-Cost Architecture)
Project Overview: Our goal is to build a contemporary, engaging platform that communicates our vision, welcomes first-time visitors, showcases our ministries, and gives easy access to sermons and church activities, with the overarching purpose of pointing everyone who visits to Jesus.
We are looking for an experienced developer who can build a high-performance, mobile-first web platform while adhering strictly to our architectural, security, and integration requirements.
Key Requirements & Scope of Work 1. Pushpay as Our Central Repository Pushpay ChMS must remain the authoritative source for all church-management information to avoid creating separate databases or duplicating information locally on the website. Specifically:
Calendar & Groups: Church calendar and public group listings must pull directly from Pushpay via API or approved embeds.
Forms & Registrations: Connection cards, event registrations, and other forms must utilize secure Pushpay forms so information stays in the central repository.
Children’s Pre-Registration: Must use a secure, approved Pushpay form process so children’s sensitive information is never stored locally on the platform.
Prayer Requests: Must utilize a confidential submission process with clear permission rules.
Online Giving: Must link seamlessly to our existing Pushpay giving platform rather than a custom payment portal.
Note on API: Please specify your technical approach for connecting the platform to Pushpay, which APIs or embeds you intend to use, and how data caching/refresh rates will be managed.
2. Design and User Experience The platform must feature:
A video-enhanced homepage hero section.
A dedicated "Plan a Visit" feature for first-time guests.
A church history timeline and member testimonials ("Why I choose and love this church").
A dedicated livestream page and a searchable, filterable sermon library.
Modern, visually appealing, mobile-friendly design with lightning-fast load times.
Clear organization for essential information: mission, vision, beliefs, leadership, ministries, service times, and physical location.
3. Content Management and Ownership
The backend must be structured so our administrative staff can easily update text, photographs, ministry information, and announcements on their own without needing developer assistance for routine changes.
4. Chatbot and Ongoing Costs
We are open to introducing a chatbot to act as a digital usher, but it must be a 100% free-tier or open-source implementation with zero recurring monthly subscription costs for hosting, usage, or maintenance. Please outline your approach for keeping all third-party tool costs at $0.
5. Security and Maintenance Please detail your proposed approach to:
Data security and protection of personal information.
Secure storage and protection of Pushpay API credentials (e.g., using environment variables).
Role-based access permissions for staff and volunteers.
Automated backups and ongoing maintenance/updates.
Disaster recovery if the platform or a connected service goes down.
6. Additional Considerations
Emergency Alert Banner: Staff must have an intuitive toggle in the backend to quickly post a site-wide notice when services are canceled or changed because of severe weather or other emergencies.
To Apply, Please Provide: Links to 2-3 recent modern web platforms you have built from scratch (church or non-profit projects are preferred).
Your technical approach to integrating Pushpay forms/embeds and handling data securely without local storage.
Your proposed milestone structure, timeline, and cost estimate.

item.title: Build a marketplace website..
item.description: 250-750 USD | Free Moving Marketplace — Website Development Project Project Overview We are seeking an experienced Bubble developer to build Free Moving Marketplace, a customer-facing moving-services marketplace initially serving the San Francisco Bay Area. We are a marketplace, not a moving company. Customers will submit moving information, receive manually prepared guaranteed price quotes, and either book at that price or participate in a moving-date auction. The website should be professional, mobile-friendly, easy to navigate, and built primarily using Bubble's existing functionality. We want a straightforward, cost-effective implementation with minimal custom development. Most administrative operations will be handled manually. Customer Accounts and Moving Inventory Customers can register, log in, and access their own moving information. Customers enter their moving date, pickup address, and delivery address. Customers can upload multiple furniture photos, upload written inventory lists, or manually select furniture and quantities from our predefined furniture catalog. We will provide the master furniture catalog, including item descriptions and cubic-foot values. The catalog must remain editable within Bubble. All customer submissions must be stored in Bubble's database and accessible to us through its built-in administrative tools. We will manually review inventories, calculate cubic footage and mileage, and determine guaranteed moving prices outside the website. We will enter the guaranteed price into Bubble and communicate it to the customer. Customers can accept their guaranteed price or enter the auction. Simplified Moving-Date Auctions We will operate one auction per moving date, with one winning customer per date. Customers click "Enter Auction" and submit a dollar bid through a simple website form. Each bid must be associated with the customer's account, moving date, and guaranteed price quote. Bid information will be recorded in Google Sheets for manual auction management. Customers compete only against others with the same moving date. We will manually calculate scores, manage rankings, close auctions, and select winners. Auction scoring formula: Score = (Customer Bid ÷ Customer Guaranteed Quote × 100) + Approved Social Media Tokens Customers are ranked by their scores, not simply by their dollar bids. Each approved social media post adds one token, equivalent to one additional score point. The website must display a simple leaderboard for each moving date showing anonymous bidder IDs, rankings, and scores. We will manage leaderboard data in Google Sheets. The website should display the leaderboard and reflect our spreadsheet updates. Customers can click "View Auction Rankings" to see their moving date's leaderboard. No automated scoring, live bidding engine, or automatic winner-selection system is required. We will manually announce the winner. The winning customer pays their winning dollar bid amount, not their guaranteed quote. They have 24 hours after the auction closes to submit payment. We will arrange moving-company fulfillment separately, outside the website. Referral and Social Media Tokens We will use Google Forms and Google Sheets to manage the referral program. Each auction participant receives a unique referral link or code to share with friends and family. Customers and their friends or family can submit links to qualifying social media posts through a Google Form. Friends and family do not need website accounts. Submissions are collected in Google Sheets. We manually review and approve social media posts. Each approved post earns one token, adding one point to the customer's auction score. We manually update token totals and auction rankings in our Google Sheets leaderboard. The website should provide customers with their referral link or code and straightforward access to the referral submission form. No custom referral-management system or automatic token approval is required. Bubble Database and Administration We want to use Bubble's existing database editor and administrative functionality rather than build a custom admin dashboard. Bubble must support: Customer accounts and login. Moving dates and pickup/delivery addresses. Furniture selections, quantities, uploaded photos, and inventory lists. Viewing and managing customer submissions. Manual entry and updating of guaranteed price quotes. Customer bids and auction information. Basic customer records and booking/payment statuses. Google Sheets will handle auction scoring, rankings, and referral tokens. Google Forms will collect social media post submissions. Stripe will handle payments. We will manually manage quotes, referral approvals, auctions, winners, payment verification, and booking confirmations. No custom administrative dashboard or reporting system is required. Any additional administrative functionality must be approved in advance. Payments and Bookings When a customer accepts their guaranteed quote, we manually send a Stripe payment link for the quoted amount. Auction winners receive a manually issued Stripe payment link for their winning bid amount, with payment due within 24 hours of auction closing. We manually email customers payment instructions and booking confirmations. We manually verify payments through Stripe and update booking/payment statuses in Bubble. Bubble only needs to store customer quotes, booking details, and payment/booking statuses. No custom Stripe integration, saved payment cards, automatic charging, or automated payment workflows are required. Customer-Facing Information Customers must be able to access the following information on the website: Their submitted moving details, inventory, and guaranteed price quote. Their submitted auction bid and moving date. Their moving-date auction leaderboard. Their booking status, such as pending or confirmed. Their referral link or code and access to the social media submission form. This information can appear on basic account pages, a simple dashboard, or other appropriate website pages. We do not require a dedicated custom dashboard. Please use whichever Bubble implementation is simplest and most cost-effective. Website Design and Technical Requirements Build the website using Bubble, within our own Bubble account. Responsive, professional design for desktop and mobile. Simple navigation and customer-friendly forms. Use Bubble's native functionality wherever practical. Google Forms and Google Sheets will support referrals and auction administration. No AI recognition, automated pricing engine, or Google Maps API integration is required. Avoid unnecessary custom code, plugins, and external services. Ownership, Accounts, Plugins, and Documentation Full ownership and independent maintainability are essential requirements.
